scope: Present evidence and proposed workflow; not all possible decoder-characterization applications

concrete_consumer.evidence: Related primary-source consumers inspected in source_check.md; no integrated candidate/decision trace in this project

required_output.evidence: Current 19-task table mixes programs and noise settings; closest schedule-selection consumer needs a feasible schedule optimizing a quantum objective

unique_uncached_tasks_per_invocation.evidence: The fixture's 19 tasks are not a measured planner invocation

cache_hit_rate_and_invalidation.evidence: Three exact historical circuit matches found; context validity and actual reuse remain unestablished

reuse_horizon.evidence: Historical training-label cost recovered; no supported deployment amortization horizon

budget_and_service_statistic.evidence: 2 ms and 5% exceedance remain diagnostics; a literature-inspired 5 ms sensitivity removes filtering savings, without reproducing that literature's contract

logical_quality.evidence: 1% whole-task logical-Z upper-bound screen is not a full application requirement or an available planner oracle

loss_tolerance_for_useful_outputs.evidence: No consumer-derived penalty or allowable feasible-rejection/objective-regret level

material_net_saving.evidence: Only partial development savings; preparation, joint quality measurement, caching and baseline search may reduce the advantage

minimum_worthwhile_absolute_saving.evidence: The provisional 20% management screen does not supply an actual consumer's absolute-value requirement

hardware_decoder_scope.evidence: Pinned one-thread CPU BP+LSD0, max_iter=30 on Apple M1 Pro, single detector sector/whole-task logical-Z

new_measurement_resource_cap.evidence: No Stage 1 timings or prospective experiment is launched

conditions_to_reopen: A concrete planner or decoder-qualification workflow with a trace of its actual uncached characterization questions
A sourced service/accuracy contract and consumer-appropriate baseline
A credible material cost case after caching, preparation, joint timing-quality observations and model/label amortization
not_claimed: A measured compiler end-to-end speedup or slowdown
A production accuracy oracle from the retrospective subset
An external human review or publication-readiness verdict
